artboards.title: Textures · pick per row or a preset

annotations.text:
Library screen, round 2 (SPEC section 10).
Shell, tokens and controls are lifted from the dashboard (light theme). Department signs now sit on the shelves in perspective. Style A figures are decided.
Night shift: dark floor, lamps only where someone works. Mutex drawn literally: Ibra waits at the front desk while Ada runs.

Focus mode: the control column, box head and legend recede; the tabs stay for navigation, Fullscreen would hide those too. Click a Fellow for the popover; "Open card" leads to the docked card of full mode.
Card docked right per DESIGN.md (canvas shrinks, no overlay on a control corner). Fields per SPEC 10.5, live run with phase bar and log tail.
Textures: pick F, W and S separately or take a preset. Everything is the same projection, so any combination works; the night palette exists for each option.
Style A decided (OPEN-15). Still open: do the figures need faces at this size?
